newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA fuel bunkers volatile, diesel falls hard.
newsitem.headline: ARA fuel bunkers volatile, diesel falls hard.

text.p: ARA fuel oil bunkers were little changed by mid to late Thursday afternoon but prices were volatile as one buyer dominated the barge market, dealers said.
The sharp drop in IPE gas oil futures, however, brought diesel and gas oil quotes down.

Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted at around $98/$99 fob after the ARA barge market had picked up from an early dip to trade at $100 fob ARA. Latest barge prices were pegged at around $96/$97 a tonne fob ARA.
Total ARA bunker market volume was low as many shipowners again postponed their enquiries. Purchasing by one refiner has not been as heavy as in the past two days.
Bunker suppliers were disgruntled at the sharp gains this week and the consequent low volumes.
Hamburg bunker prices were sharply higher with a return of buying, some of it emergency coverage.
Mediterranean bunkers also had to catch up with Rotterdam gains, although fuel oil in most ports was only about $1/$2 a tonne higher. Few suppliers clinched many deals.
